title: The House of the Rising Sun

sections.name: Verse
sections.chords: Am | C | D | F | Am | C | E | E | Am | C | D | F | Am | E | Am

sources.label: Richter Guitar, House of the Rising Sun – The Animals (verse in four lines, 6/8, F as a barre, optional E7)

notes: Richter Guitar writes the verse as Am C D F / Am C E E / Am C D F / Am E Am. One chord per bar here; bar lengths aren't given, especially in the last line, so check by ear. E7 can stand in for E.

picking.description: Arpeggiated chords in 6/8, in A minor. The recording is played with a pick; fingerstyle versions usually use a p-i-m-a-m-i style roll. Verify by ear.
